subject: Anna Callahan Campaign Launch
overview: Climate activist Craig Altemose spoke in personal support of Anna Callahan's campaign for State Representative in the 34th Middlesex District, emphasizing climate justice and State House reform.

items.title: Craig Altemose Remarks
items.summary: Craig Altemose spoke in favor of Anna Callahan's candidacy, arguing that enacting a Green New Deal requires legislators willing to challenge leadership and the existing culture in the State House.
